scope: next-idea generation and selection in reconstructed mathematical research contexts
judges: all other selected providers; no self-judging
order_algorithm: sort each canonical idea by sha256(seed + ':' + canonical_idea_id), ascending hex; relabel C1..CK

usefulness_scale.3: concrete strategy addressing an important obstacle, substantial verification remains
usefulness_scale.4: actionable idea addressing the key obstacle with checkable support

candidate_usefulness: mean of all expected peer judges only when all numeric; no peers means null
strict_core_match: all expected peer judges label core; no peers means null

metric_eligibility.selected_usefulness: selection and every expected peer numeric usefulness rating present
metric_eligibility.best_usefulness: all K candidates have every expected peer numeric rating
metric_eligibility.any_core_match: all K have every expected peer determinate agreement label
metric_eligibility.selected_core_match: selection has every expected peer determinate agreement label

primary_comparison: same checkpoint revision and repeat index with all selected generators eligible for that metric

human_audit.sampling: smallest sha256(seed + ':' + idea_uuid) within each stratum

version_change: new immutable protocol and new plan; never rewrite an executed plan

free_tier.usage_scope: respect remaining organization quota after other apps; app estimates are not official measurements

runtime_constraints.api_experiments: cloud DB cron + short Edge units while project active and quotas available
runtime_constraints.long_sync_inference: unsupported unless capability validated within 100 second request budget
